remarks: Discover the perfect balance of comfort and convenience in this 2-bedroom, 2-bath, 3-level townhouse in Norwalk's sought-after Sunrise Hill community. From the moment you step inside, you're welcomed by a bright living room with hardwood floors and a wood-burning fireplace-setting the scene for cozy nights and casual gatherings. The Eat-in kitchen is designed for both style and function, with granite counters, stainless steel appliances, and a brand-new reverse osmosis drinking system so you can enjoy fresh, clean water every day. A beautifully updated full bath with modern finishes completes the main floor. Upstairs, two inviting bedrooms provide plenty of space to relax and recharge. The primary suite features two walk-in closets, while a full bath with both tub and shower offers comfort and convenience. The lower level opens up even more possibilities with flexible room perfect for a media space, playroom, home office or guest retreat. The separate laundry / exercise area keeps your home running smoothly while adding extra flexibility and even more storage space! Step outside to your private fenced patio, surrounded by greenery-an ideal spot for morning coffee, a summer barbecue, or unwinding at the end of the day. Life at Sunrise Hill means more than just a home-it's a lifestyle. Spend sunny afternoons by the pool, get active on the tennis and pickleball courts, or let little ones enjoy the playground.
